title: rourea nitida
intro: Rourea nitida, commonly known as the poison tree, is a plant species native to tropical Africa and Asia, and is part of the Connaraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has shown potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help reduce pain and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Rourea nitida include its ability to act as an antiseptic and antibacterial agent, making it useful for wound healing and infections. The plant's bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are still being studied for their potential benefits.
